messages.content: You are a network engineer. Always use Loopback0 for BGP router-id and enable log-neighbor-changes.
Configure BGP for AS 65001 with neighbor 192.168.1.2 in AS 65002

interface Loopback0
 description BGP_ROUTER_ID
 ip address 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
!
router bgp 65001
 bgp router-id 10.1.1.1
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 neighbor 192.168.1.2 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 192.168.1.2 activate
You are a network engineer. Always use AS 65001
